# @ic-reactor/cli — AI Quick Guide

CLI for explicit, repeatable IC Reactor code generation from `.did` files.

## Install and Run

```bash
pnpm add -D @ic-reactor/cli
pnpm exec ic-reactor init
pnpm exec ic-reactor generate
```

Requires Node.js 22.12+ (`commander@15`).

`init` writes to the current directory only; a config in a parent directory is
never modified. `init -y` is fully non-interactive and keeps an existing config
rather than replacing it.

## Configuration

- Primary config file: `ic-reactor.json`
- JSON Schema: `./node_modules/@ic-reactor/cli/schema.json`
- Key fields: `outDir`, `clientManagerPath`, `target`, `canisters`

The config is validated before generation; violations throw `CodegenConfigError`.
`outDir` must resolve inside the project root. Canister names must match
`CANISTER_NAME_PATTERN`. Each canister needs its own `outDir` — codegen writes a
`.ic-reactor-owner` marker and refuses to let a second canister write into a
directory another canister owns. A `.did` that produces no `idlFactory` is
rejected.

## Target Modes

- `react`: reactor + typed hook exports
- `core`: typed reactor exports only (no React dependency)

## Generated Files

- Managed: `index.generated.ts` (overwritten every generation)
- Stable wrapper: `index.ts` (safe to customize)

Do not hand-edit `index.generated.ts`.

`generate --clean` removes the output directories of canisters that are no
longer in the config (the renamed-canister case). Configured canisters are left
alone — their files are rewritten by the run itself.

`--clean` is ignored (with a warning) when combined with `--canister <name>`: it
decides what is stale by comparing the directories on disk against the full
configured set, and a single-canister run says nothing about the others. It
removes only directories carrying codegen's own `Auto-generated by
@ic-reactor/codegen` header, and never follows symlinks, so hand-written
directories under `outDir` are safe.

## CLI vs Vite Plugin

- Use CLI for CI/non-Vite/manual generation pipelines
- Use `@ic-reactor/vite-plugin` for watch-mode generation in Vite apps

## Full References

- Full AI guide: https://ic-reactor.b3pay.net/llms-full.txt
- CLI docs: https://ic-reactor.b3pay.net/v3/packages/cli
